Daily toner pad infused with SKIN1004’s exclusive Centella Asiatica extract to instantly soothe irritated skin. Ultra-thin, soft-textured pad gently glides over sensitive skin without friction. Quick and easy 1-step prep before makeup or morning skincare routine Ideal for calming heat-induced redness or rebalancing skin after cleansing.
Centella Soothing Cream 75ml:
Barrier-strengthening cream powered by Centella Asiatica extract and multi-ceramide complex. Gentle yet effective formula comforts easily irritated and sensitive skin. 1. Place the pads on your cheeks, forehead, or specific areas of concern for 3–5 minutes. Remove them, then gently pat to help absorb the remaining essence. After opening the product, please keep the included lid and tweezer inside for convenient use.
